supports: deterministic Rule execution and replay integrity

dataset_limitations: The twelve frozen records are noisy extracts. SRC007, SRC009 and SRC011 are byte-identical truncated copies; SRC006 and SRC010 repeat a 2025 systemic-risk abstract; several records contain scraper chrome, only abstracts or tangential general material.

The Draft spans the acute October 1907–January 1908 panic and the later 1913 legislative outcome. Twenty logical coordinates preserve order but do not estimate days, months, institutional latency or crisis duration.
The Draft roster has 16 distinct IDs and skips P_8. No participant or clearing-agent authority is inferred to fill that integer gap.

Draft E2 transactions misidentify endpoints, E4 relationships assign aid/service actions to depositors, E6 reverses lender/funder roles, and E8 bailout transactions target depositors. Current actor-local rows and coherent descriptions govern authority; no money ledger is created.

Stock targeting, bank affiliation, being run on, aid receipt, exchange stress, systemic liquidity receipt and Federal Reserve establishment are passive context or results unless a bounded choice owner is explicit.
Aggregate depositor, trust, member-bank and gold-flow records do not provide individual trajectories, probabilities, balances, conserved transfers, uniformity or causal coefficients.

Full Draft exposure and authored logical-time compression preclude unbiased prediction, historical fit, calibration, counterfactual rescue effects, policy effectiveness, held-out or scientific-validity claims.
